svg.title: FlashRNN2: separate recurrence from observation
svg.desc: Two homologous panels show R/b feeding recurrent MMA, U_t feeding state update, local S_t feedback and separate Y_t writes. The baseline exposes a final snapshot view; FlashRNN2 can expose independent FP32 chunk carry. Notes distinguish inheritance, implemented changes and proposed overlap.

text.tspan: Generic LSTM / sLSTM | FP16 / BF16 | inference forward | source-observed
